test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT connected with India's space programmes?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Sriperumbudur**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sriperumbudur is a town panchayat in the Kanchipuram** district of the Indian state of Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is located 40 kilometres southwest of the capital city of Chennai on National Highway 4 and is just outside the Chennai Metropolitan Area and part of the Chennai suburban area.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Satish Dhawan Space Centre - SDSC (formerly Sriharikota Range - SHAR) is a rocket launch centre (spaceport) operated by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**. It is located in Sriharikota in Andhra Pradesh. Sriharikota Range was renamed in 2002 after ISRO's former chairman Satish Dhawan.
 
• **Thumba Equatorial Rocket Launching Station is an Indian spaceport established on 21 November 1963**. Operated by the Indian Space Research Organisation, it is located in Thumba, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, which is near the southern tip of mainland India, very close to the earth's magnetic equator.
 
• Dr Abdul Kalam Island, formerly known as Wheeler Island, is an island **off the coast of Odisha, India, approximately 150 kilometres east of the state capital Bhubaneswar**.
